problem.summary: The numeric gate validated reviewer-entered observed references against an allowed vocabulary, while still-render provenance separately validated sealed files. The allowed vocabulary itself was not machine-bound to the canonical 4K manifest view/crop identities and temporal probe identities. A future configuration drift could therefore leave stale or aliased review references that looked valid syntactically but no longer named the canonical evidence objects.
riskToGate: A stale allowedCropRefs entry could survive a capture-manifest change.
A manifest crop id could silently point at a differently named canonical file without the review vocabulary detecting the identity drift.
A temporal review reference could drift from the actual temporal-stability probe set.
Category or critical-defect requirements could retain orphan references after a vocabulary edit.

implementation.change: Added fail-closed set equality between observability allowedViews and manifest viewIds; exact equality between allowedCropRefs and manifest viewId/cropId pairs; canonical dimension-bearing crop-path derivation; resampled=false enforcement; exact equality between allowedTemporalRefs and temporal probe ids; and orphan/duplicate requirement rejection.
Added machine-readable non-weakenable policy defining exact view/crop/probe identity binding. It explicitly awards zero Visual Fidelity points and cannot clear critical defects.
Integrated reference binding into the core gate-integrity entry point already invoked by direct numeric-gate evaluation, CLI/reflection paths and the native 4K packet.

issuesFoundAndCorrected.issue: The first canonical crop-path formatter omitted the existing _1280x720 dimension segment and would have rejected the valid current manifest.
issuesFoundAndCorrected.correction: Changed canonical path derivation to Assets/QA/Captures4K/{viewId}_crop_{cropId}_{width}x{height}_100pct.png, added positive crop-dimension checks, and aligned the machine-readable contract.

sourceDataChecks: Current observability allowedViews matches manifest viewIds: hero, oblique, grazing.
Current observability allowedCropRefs matches all 11 manifest viewId/cropId identities.
All 11 manifest crop paths follow the dimension-bearing canonical path convention and are marked resampled=false.
Current allowedTemporalRefs matches temporal probe ids: subpixel_grazing and lod_walk_oblique.
Temporal requiredProbeRefsForTemporalCategory is the complete two-probe set.
Category and critical-defect required view/crop/temporal references are subsets of the bound vocabularies.

expectedVisualScoreImpact.expectedEffectAfterRealRender: No image-quality point is earned by this change. It raises evidence integrity across all nine categories and all critical-defect reviews by preventing reviewer references from drifting away from the canonical sealed still/temporal evidence identities.
